scoring_contract.input: raw nonnegative gene counts with explicit measured-gene mask
scoring_contract.signed_score: mean(log1p_CP10K[measured_up_genes]) - mean(log1p_CP10K[measured_down_genes]); empty down list contributes exactly zero

programs.source_hypothesis: iCMS2 intrinsic epithelial state-associated signed marker program defined from external colorectal epithelial single-cell transcriptomes.
limitations: Spatial spots are mixed-cell measurements; these scores are source-associated molecular proxies, not measured cell abundance or cell-intrinsic activity.
Program membership is fixed using the external publication only; target cohort expression, pathology labels, survival endpoints and predictive performance were not used to select genes.
Preserve exact published gene strings; no silent alias, case, whitespace or unsupported-gene replacement. Coverage and missingness must be audited separately.
This is a continuous signed program score, not a validated iCMS subtype call in the current ST cohort.
The source publication evaluated these programs in TCGA and other bulk cohorts; this program import must not be described as external confirmation of future TCGA survival results.
